title: Benchmark Appendix v2: Split by Label Type
caveat: Detection-rate numbers are not directly comparable across Tables A and B because the label models differ fundamentally. Table A uses expert-curated or algorithmic crossing times; Table B uses heuristic thresholds or phenomenological criteria. Mixing rows from both tables in a single comparison is invalid.

baseline_comparison.note: All detectors run on the same THEMIS-A Oct 2008 window against 118 curated Zenodo V2 crossings.
baseline_comparison.key_finding: CD associator matches PVI sensitivity (89.0% vs 89.8%) with half the false alarm rate (16.7% vs 31.1%). The CD observable adds selectivity beyond standard diagnostics.

table_a_curated_benchmarks.main_caveat: V1 heliosheath conditions differ from V2
Strongest Earth result. Single probe, single 7-day window.
Bow shock is noisier; foreshock turbulence generates extra transitions
Compact magnetosphere; many sub-structures not in MP-only list

table_b_heuristic_generalization.main_caveat: Heuristic labels; Jan 2024 not a dayside MP interval
Cleanest heuristic result; curated IMB list upgrade available
40% genuine directional phase geometry, 60% normalization amplification
Regime classification, not point events; possible radial trend
Spectral-only signal destroyed by phase randomization
Radial-distance-dependent; no fast/slow discrimination at 1 AU

decomposition_summary.Q1_phase_vs_spectral: Real < shared-phase < indep-phase: organized phase coupling suppresses associator (R/I = 0.25-0.67)
decomposition_summary.Q2_transverse_vs_compressive: At dipolar boundaries, compressive modes elevate associator (r=-0.42 MMS). Induced: independent.
decomposition_summary.Q3_induced_vs_dipole: Induced FA = 17.6%, dipole FA = 51.2%. Selectivity difference, partially label-confounded.
decomposition_summary.Q4_normalization: Only Rosetta (near-zero |B|) is normalization-sensitive. All others: ratio ~1.0.
decomposition_summary.Q5_disagreements: FN = partial/grazing crossings. FA = real TDs/FTEs/mirrors not in curated lists (attribution pending).
